item.title: Two arrests after McDonald’s drive-thru laughing gas incident
item.description: Two suspects were arrested for a catalogue of offences following reports of drug-taking inside a car. Newark officers attended McDonald’s in Lincoln Road after hearing people were inhaling laughing gas at the drive-thru. The response team arrived at 12.40am on Friday (19 December) to find a car matching the one described heading for the exit. […]

item.title: Burglar who targeted student accommodation awaits New Year for sentencing
item.description: A prolific thief who repeatedly burgled student accommodation will start the new year behind bars. Christos Iona targeted the same Beeston-based student apartments on five separate occasions during his crime spree. item.description: Work on Mansfield’s Four Seasons Shopping Centre car park is due to start on 5 January and is expected to last around 40 weeks.
